steps.note: Run a basic command (string shorthand): echo hello world, which prints "hello world".
Run a command with arguments (object format): command echo, args hello and world.
Test a failure condition: exit 1 passes because exitCodes lists 1.
Set a variable: echo setup and capture stdout into TEST.
Echo $TEST and validate that the output is setup.
